project.title: Cross-Line Hygiene and Changeover Optimization
project.objective: Standardize and improve cleaning and changeover procedures between food and metal lines to reduce downtime and contamination risk.
deliverables: Documented standard cleaning and changeover procedures for food lines
Documented standard cleaning and changeover procedures for metal sawing area
Unified hygiene and safety checklist for shared equipment and forklifts
Training briefings and on-the-job coaching plan for all shifts
Baseline and target metrics for downtime and cleaning duration
Incident logging routine for hygiene or equipment issues
constraints: All procedures must comply with internal food safety and metal safety standards
No full production stop longer than 2 hours per line for testing new procedures
New routines must be applicable across all shifts with existing staffing levels
Forklift and shared equipment availability is limited during peak dispatch hours
Documentation must be simple enough to be used on the shop floor
Changes must be fully rolled out within one month

risks.risk: Operators do not consistently follow the new cleaning and changeover steps.
risks.mitigation: Create simple visual checklists, run short shift-start refreshers, and spot-check adherence in the first weeks.

risks.risk: Cleaning and changeover take longer than expected, increasing downtime.
risks.mitigation: Pilot procedures on one line, time each step, and remove non-essential actions before full rollout.

risks.risk: Misalignment between food safety and metal safety requirements for shared equipment.
risks.mitigation: Involve quality assurance and maintenance in defining shared-equipment rules and sign-off criteria.

risks.risk: Communication gaps between shifts lead to inconsistent practices.
risks.mitigation: Introduce a simple shift handover log focused on hygiene, incidents, and pending actions.

themes.theme: Cleaning in place and manual cleaning routines
themes.why_relevant: Core to reducing contamination risk and ensuring consistent hygiene across food lines.
Directly impacts throughput; operators must balance speed with thorough cleaning.
Forklifts and tools move between areas and can transfer residues or debris if unmanaged.
Early detection of hygiene or equipment issues prevents rework and product loss.

themes.theme: Cross-area coordination between food and metal lines
themes.why_relevant: Metal and food teams must align schedules and safety rules for shared spaces.

backlog.task: Map current cleaning and changeover steps on all food production lines
definition_of_done: Each food line has a listed sequence of current cleaning and changeover steps
Average time per step is estimated based on operator input
Pain points and frequent delays are noted for each line

backlog.task: Document current cleaning and chip-removal routine for metal sawing area
definition_of_done: Metal sawing cleaning steps are listed with tools and materials used
Areas with frequent metal chip buildup are identified
Any overlap with shared equipment or walkways is documented

backlog.task: Draft standard cleaning in place (CIP) checklist for food production equipment
definition_of_done: Checklist covers pre-rinse, wash, rinse, and verification steps
Checklist includes safety lockout and chemical handling notes
Checklist is reviewed by at least two operators from different shifts

backlog.task: Create unified hygiene checklist for forklifts and shared tools
definition_of_done: Checklist includes pre-shift and post-shift cleaning points
Metal and food area requirements are both reflected
Checklist is short enough to complete in under 5 minutes

backlog.task: Define quick visual quality checks after cleaning on food lines
definition_of_done: List of visual checks (residue, moisture, foreign objects) is created
Checks are mapped to specific machine zones
Operators agree that checks can be done within the allowed time

backlog.task: Define quick visual quality checks after cleaning in metal sawing area
definition_of_done: List of visual checks for chips, oil, and dust is created
Critical safety zones around blades and guards are highlighted
Checks are validated with a maintenance technician

backlog.task: Pilot new cleaning and changeover sequence on one food line
definition_of_done: Pilot line is selected and communicated to all shifts
New sequence is tested for at least three full changeovers
Actual cleaning and changeover times are recorded and compared to baseline

backlog.task: Pilot updated cleaning routine on one metal sawing machine
definition_of_done: One machine is selected for the pilot and marked accordingly
New routine is followed for at least three cleaning cycles
Feedback on feasibility and time impact is collected

backlog.task: Prepare short training briefing for operators on new procedures
definition_of_done: Key changes for food and metal areas are summarized in simple language
Briefing fits into a 10–15 minute toolbox talk format
Examples of common mistakes and how to avoid them are included

backlog.task: Set up simple incident log for hygiene or cleaning-related issues
definition_of_done: Log format is defined with date, area, issue, and quick fix fields
Log can be filled in quickly during or after shift
Process for reviewing logs weekly is agreed with supervisors

backlog.task: Align changeover windows between food lines and metal sawing area
definition_of_done: Typical busy and quiet periods are listed for both areas
Preferred time windows for deep cleaning are proposed
At least one shared window per day is agreed for both areas

backlog.task: Summarize final standard procedures and share with all shifts
definition_of_done: Final versions of checklists and routines are consolidated
Printed or posted copies are available in relevant work areas
Operators confirm they know where to find the procedures

artifacts.title: Food Line CIP and Changeover Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Guides food production operators through each cleaning and changeover step with verification points.

artifacts.title: Metal Sawing Cleaning and Chip-Removal Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Standardizes cleaning and inspection of metal sawing machines and surrounding area.

artifacts.title: Shared Equipment and Forklift Hygiene Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Ensures forklifts and shared tools are cleaned before moving between food and metal areas.

artifacts.title: Cleaning and Changeover Time Tracking Sheet
artifacts.used_for: Captures baseline and pilot cleaning times to compare performance and identify bottlenecks.

artifacts.title: Operator Briefing: New Hygiene and Changeover Standards
artifacts.used_for: Provides a concise overview of new routines and expectations for all shifts.

artifacts.title: Hygiene and Cleaning Incident Log
artifacts.used_for: Records hygiene-related issues, root causes, and quick fixes for weekly review.

artifacts.title: Cross-Area Cleaning and Changeover Procedure Summary
artifacts.used_for: Consolidates final procedures for food and metal areas into a single reference document.

artifacts.title: Shift Handover Notes for Hygiene and Equipment Status
artifacts.used_for: Captures key hygiene and equipment notes between outgoing and incoming shifts.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current cleaning and changeover practices and main issues.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message asking operators to describe how they currently clean and change over lines.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree which food line and which metal sawing machine will be used as pilots.
Confirm what information must be captured in the time tracking sheet.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Draft and refine the new cleaning and changeover checklists.
threads_plan.trigger: Post first draft of food and metal cleaning steps and ask for operator feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the structure and sequence of the food line CIP checklist.
Approve the structure and sequence of the metal sawing cleaning checklist.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define rules for shared equipment and forklift hygiene between areas.
threads_plan.trigger: Message raising concerns about forklifts and tools moving between food and metal zones.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on minimum cleaning steps before a forklift enters food areas.
Decide how often shared equipment hygiene checks must be logged.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan and review pilot runs for new procedures on selected lines.
threads_plan.trigger: Announcement that pilot cleaning and changeover routines will start on the chosen line and machine.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm pilot schedule and which shifts will participate first.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize procedures, training briefing, and incident logging routine.
threads_plan.trigger: Post summary of pilot results and propose final standard procedures and training plan.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve final procedure summary and go-live date for all shifts.

channel_rituals: Daily short async update at shift start on any hygiene or cleaning issues noticed.
Weekly summary post reviewing incident log entries and time tracking trends.
Pre-pilot and post-pilot check-in threads to capture expectations and feedback.
End-of-week Q&A thread for clarifying doubts about new procedures.
Monthly mini-retrospective on what is working or needs adjustment in the routines.
